name: Railway Recruitment Cells / Boards - Group D (Level-1 Posts) Examination

conducting_body.name: Railway Recruitment Cells (RRC) / Railway Recruitment Control Board (RRB), Ministry of Railways
conducting_body.headquarters: Rail Bhavan, Raisina Road, New Delhi 110001

official_sources.name: Railway Recruitment Boards Centralized Application Portal (RRB Apply)
Centralised Employment Notice (CEN) for Level-1 (Group D) Posts 2026
Official Railway Recruitment Boards Group D Historical Question Papers Corpus (2018-2025)

cbt.nature: Single Stage Computer Based Examination for Merit Selection

sections.name: General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences up to 10th standard CBSE/NCERT)

pet.male_criteria: Should be able to lift and carry 35 kg of weight for a distance of 100 meters in 2 minutes in one chance without putting the weight down; and should be able to run for a distance of 1000 meters in 4 minutes and 15 seconds in one chance.
pet.female_criteria: Should be able to lift and carry 20 kg of weight for a distance of 100 meters in 2 minutes in one chance without putting the weight down; and should be able to run for a distance of 1000 meters in 5 minutes and 40 seconds in one chance.

subsequent_stages.document_verification: Document Verification based on normalized marks in CBT
subsequent_stages.medical_examination: Strict Railway Medical Examination according to post standards (A-2, A-3, B-1, B-2, C-1, C-2)

posts_and_pay_scales.pay_level: Level 1 (₹18,000 initial pay plus risk & running allowances)

eligibility_criteria.age_limit: 18 to 33 years (Age relaxation: OBC +3 years, SC/ST +5 years)
eligibility_criteria.educational_qualification: 10th pass (Matriculation) from a recognized Board / Council OR National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT OR ITI from institutions recognized by NCVT/SCVT.
